<function name="Unpack" parent="VMatrix" type="classfunc">
	<description>Returns each component of the matrix, expanding rows before columns.</description>
	<realm>Shared</realm>
	<rets>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(1, 1)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(1, 2)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(1, 3)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(1, 4)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(2, 1)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(2, 2)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(2, 3)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(2, 4)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(3, 1)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(3, 2)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(3, 3)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(3, 4)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(4, 1)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(4, 2)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(4, 3)</ret>
		<ret name="" type="number"><page>VMatrix:GetField</page>(4, 4)</ret>
	</rets>
</function>
